sample.title: Simple
sample.description: Includes utilities to simplify common use cases like store setup, creating reducers, immutable update logic, and more.

sample.title: Opinionated
sample.description: Provides good defaults for store setup out of the box, and includes the most commonly used Redux addons built-in.

sample.title: Powerful
sample.description: Takes inspiration from libraries like Immer and Autodux to let you write "mutative" immutable update logic, and even create entire "slices" of state automatically.

sample.title: Effective
sample.description: Lets you focus on the core logic your app needs, so you can do more work with less code.
